economic_summary.gross_definition: sum(fill_size * (1 - fill_price)) for public winner-token last_trade_price events whose CLOB source time followed local receipt of the exact closing TWAP and whose side was SELL

method.causal_observation: The exact Chainlink BTC/USD TWAP-60 event whose source timestamp equaled market end, using local receipt time rather than future resolution time.
method.fill_filter: Winner-token CLOB last_trade_price event, side SELL, CLOB source time at or after exact closing-TWAP local receipt.
method.fresh_bid_proxy: A positive change in aggregate winner-token BUY size at price 0.99 or 0.999 after exact closing-TWAP local receipt.
method.outcome_check: Exact opening and closing TWAP values implied Up or Down and matched the later public market_resolved winner in every complete row.

unresolved_gates: Aggregate public price_change growth does not expose account order creation time or prove that a new authenticated order was accepted after the oracle observation.
Public last_trade_price events prove market matching but not bot-owned fill lineage, queue position, cancellation behavior, or achievable prospective quantity.
The retained run is one degraded BTC hour from 2026-08-14; ETH SOL date and current-regime persistence are unproved.
Exact account maker fees rebates settlement redemption relayer opportunity cost and pUSD availability are unbound.
No live-money authority exists and no order may be submitted from this artifact.
next_action: Freeze one minimum-size no-crossing authenticated order-acceptance probe only after the protected boundary and explicit authority; before that, run a public prospective BTC ETH SOL observation-to-close monitor that records exact oracle receipt, CLOB source time, bid growth, trade side, and book clear time without orders.
